import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
p=Path('research-20260929/publication').resolve()
w=p/'reviews/minor-fixes'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='minor-fixes-r3-') as directory:
    copy=Path(directory)/'control'
    for rel in ['checks/dtoc5_reference_check.py', 'sources/qplib/QPLIB_8585.sol', 'sources/qplib/QPLIB_8585_excerpt.txt', 'sources/mittelmann_cnconv/logs/QPLIB_8585.mnt']:
        dest=copy/rel
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(p/'literature/control'/rel,dest)
    command=[sys.executable,str(copy/'checks/dtoc5_reference_check.py')]
    result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=copy,text=True,capture_output=True)
    print('Disposable command:',command,'affinity:',sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)))
    print(result.stdout,end='')
    print(result.stderr,end='',file=sys.stderr)
    (w/'dtoc5_reference_r3.log').write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr)
    assert result.returncode==0,result.returncode
    (p/'literature/control/checks/dtoc5_reference_check.log').write_text(result.stdout)
PY
